senses.gloss: m. (transpos. of מַזְלֵג) pitch-fork; the cook’s fork.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:2">Sabb. XVII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 122b">122ᵇ</cite>; Mish. a.
